definitions.explanation: The air breathed in and out, and the act of breathing.
In set phrases, breathing stands for the shared rhythm of people working together (息が合う) or for a pause to relax (息を抜く).

examples.japanese: {息|いき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れた→切れる：01936_kireru⟧。
{息|いき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吐|は}いて→吐く：04397_haku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{息|いき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}めて→止める：00678_tomeru⟧。

examples.english: In winter, your breath turns white.

examples.japanese: ⟦{深|ふか}く→深い：01211_fukai⟧{息|いき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吸|す}いましょう→吸う：04394_suu⟧。
⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}がって→上がる：00615_agaru⟧{息|いき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{荒|あら}く→荒い：00466_arai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I was breathing heavily after climbing the stairs.

examples.japanese: {息|いき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I need time to take a breather.

examples.japanese: ⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{息|いき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}えた→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧。
examples.english: I caught my breath after running.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{息|いき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ぴったり→ぴったり：02362_pittari⟧だ。
examples.english: They have worked together for a long time, so they are perfectly in step.

notes:
{息|いき} refers to both the physical breath (air inhaled/exhaled) and the act of breathing (sense 1). In set phrases it also stands for the rhythm people share when working together and for a pause to relax (sense 2).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {息|いき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吸|す}う→吸う：04394_suu⟧: to inhale
- {息|いき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吐|は}く→吐く：04397_haku⟧: to exhale
- ⟦{息|いき}を{止|と}める→息を止める：21418_ikiwotomeru⟧: to hold one's breath
- {息|いき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧: to be out of breath
- {息|いき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{荒|あら}い→荒い：00466_arai⟧: to be breathing heavily
- {息|いき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧: to catch one's breath
- {息|いき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to be in sync, to work well together
- {息|いき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧: to take a breather, to relax
- {息|いき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to gasp (in surprise or awe)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{溜息|ためいき}→溜息：04502_tameiki⟧: sigh
- ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧: son (unrelated to breath; the compound is read as a whole)
- ⟦{息切|いきぎ}れ→息切れ：06300_ikigire⟧: shortness of breath
